clue.text: Discordant kid orchestra to ring a bell

indicators.note: discordant music is jarring and out of order, so these letters are jumbled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A band of children plays so badly it sets the ears ringing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discordant' signals that the twelve letters of KID ORCHESTRA are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Both idioms mean to stir a memory or sound familiar, prompting recognition.

clue.text: Conveying passengers requires assembly of trains on time

indicators.note: assembling parts means putting them together in a fresh order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A railway service depends on putting trains together punctually.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembly of' rearranges TRAINS into TRANSI, then T for time is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Transit is the carrying of people or goods from place to place, as in public transport.

clue.text: Brave girl, cheeky, joins Northern Ireland rising

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the whole run of letters is read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name, as for Diana
pert means saucy or cheeky

explanation.surface: A bold, cheeky young woman joins an uprising in Ulster.
explanation.walkthrough: DI + PERT + NI gives DIPERTNI; 'rising' turns that whole run upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Intrepid is a synonym for fearless or courageous.

clue.text: Make vessel heard

indicators.note: heard tells us the word for the vessel is said out loud, and a word sounding like it is entered

parts.note: an urn is a vase or container

explanation.surface: An instruction to make a pot audible.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent URN and the answer sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: To make money is to gain income, a synonym sense.

clue.text: Can diminutive Helen, working one, produce pasta dish? Yes

parts.note: taken as written
Nell is a pet form of the name Helen
on means functioning or working, as a switched-on machine
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A question whether little Helen, busy in the kitchen, can produce an Italian dish, answered yes.
explanation.walkthrough: The closing 'Yes' just affirms the question; it gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannelloni are large pasta tubes, usually stuffed and baked.

clue.text: Go round the globe with it

parts.note: an orb is a sphere, a globe
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to circle the world while carrying something.
explanation.definitionFit: To orbit is to travel in a circular path around a body, as a satellite does.

clue.text: 70% of book of words used in speech

indicators.note: seventy per cent of a ten-letter word keeps only its opening seven letters

parts.note: a dictionary is a reference book

explanation.surface: A statement about most of a vocabulary book being used when talking.
explanation.walkthrough: DICTIONARY has ten letters; keeping 70% leaves the first seven.
explanation.definitionFit: Diction is the choice and use of words, and the manner of enunciating them.

clue.text: Delay for a crate with tins to be rearranged

parts.note: pro means in favour of, i.e. for

indicators.note: states plainly that these letters are shuffled into a new order

explanation.surface: Putting things off while waiting for a crate of tins to be reorganised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is not just a link: it gives PRO; 'to be rearranged' shuffles A CRATE and TINS.
explanation.definitionFit: To procrastinate is to put off doing something, to dawdle.

clue.text: Pronounce Adam's ale with gin cocktail delicious

parts.note: to mouth words is to utter or form them
Adam's ale is a humorous old term for water, the only drink of the first man

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Calling water mixed with gin a tasty drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cocktail' rearranges GIN into ING.
explanation.definitionFit: Mouth-watering food looks or smells so tasty it makes saliva flow.

clue.text: Military engineers play with Oregon power source

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, the British Army's engineering corps
to act is to play a part
OR is the postal abbreviation for Oregon

explanation.surface: Army engineers play about in Oregon with a source of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A nuclear reactor generates heat to drive electricity generation.

clue.text: Cuban-backed company to produce Verdi opera

indicators.note: backed is read as written backwards, so the word Cuban is turned round

explanation.surface: A Havana-financed firm stages an Italian opera.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' reverses CUBAN to give NABUC.
explanation.definitionFit: Verdi's early opera about Nebuchadnezzar, famous for the Chorus of Hebrew Slaves.

clue.text: Social classification rejected by English

parts.note: cast as in cast off or cast aside, meaning thrown away

explanation.surface: A class system the English refuse to accept.
explanation.definitionFit: A caste is a hereditary social class, as in the traditional Hindu system.

clue.text: Limit stricter arrangement

indicators.note: an arrangement puts things in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Imposing a cap through a tougher set of rules.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' rearranges the letters of STRICTER.
explanation.definitionFit: To restrict is to confine or keep within bounds, a synonym sense.

clue.text: Dig and let cart out from restraint on farm

indicators.note: out here means disordered or not in place, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A farmer told to dig out a trapped cart from some barrier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges DIG and LET CART together.
explanation.definitionFit: A cattle grid is a set of bars over a ditch in a road, which livestock will not cross.

clue.text: Get faulty bale -it's within reach

parts.note: to attain is to achieve or obtain

indicators.note: faulty means flawed or out of order, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Picking up a broken hay bale because it is close at hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faulty' rearranges BALE into ABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something attainable can be achieved or reached.

clue.text: Wintry weather is coming from south at the moment

parts.note: now means currently, at the present moment

explanation.surface: A weather forecast saying a cold front is arriving from the south right now.
explanation.definitionFit: Falling flakes of frozen water are the typical cold-season precipitation.

clue.text: Wise man swallows medication in drop of liquid

indicators.note: one word swallowing another takes it inside itself

parts.note: a sage is a wise person
a pill is a tablet of medicine

explanation.surface: A wise elder takes a tablet with a drop of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drop' looks like a verb or a single bead, but the definition is the whole phrase for liquid that has been spilt.
explanation.definitionFit: Spillage is liquid that has overflowed or been spilt.

clue.text: Measure binding material

definitions.meaning: a ... measure, used for measuring length
adhesive or fabric strip used to bind or seal things

explanation.definitionFit: A tape measure measures length; sticky or fabric strips are used for binding.

clue.text: Dry up after salesman goes over alarm

indicators.note: after places the dry piece behind the salesman piece in the answer
going over, as in flipping over, means the word is turned round

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means read from the bottom, so the word is reversed

parts.note: brut describes very dry champagne

explanation.surface: A dried-up salesman, finished, is caused distress.
explanation.walkthrough: Both reversals are signalled separately: 'goes over' for the salesman, 'up' (in a down clue) for the dry wine, and 'after' orders them.
explanation.definitionFit: To perturb is to disturb or make anxious, a synonym sense.

clue.text: Put up with fielder in position

parts.note: to stand something is to tolerate it
point is a fielding position in cricket, square of the batsman on the off side

explanation.surface: Tolerating a cricket fielder in his position.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, point is a fielder placed square on the off side, near the batsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A standpoint is a viewpoint or stance from which things are judged.

clue.text: One gets exclusive information at home and rides off

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: off means awry or wrong, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone stays home while others ride away, yet still gets the gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges RIDES into SIDER.
explanation.definitionFit: An insider is someone within an organisation with privileged knowledge.

clue.text: Vikings and not Home Counties people

parts.note: nor means and not
the Home Counties around London lie in the South East, SE
men means people, persons

explanation.surface: Saying Vikings are not from the counties around London.
explanation.walkthrough: The Home Counties are the counties surrounding London, in England's South East.
explanation.definitionFit: Norsemen were the medieval Scandinavians, raiders and seafarers.

clue.text: The Spanish and the German are born earlier

parts.note: el is the Spanish masculine definite article, the
der is the German masculine definite article, the

explanation.surface: A Spaniard and a German were born before the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: An elder sibling is one born first, older than another.

clue.text: Not a winner among them -they're so lazy going round

indicators.note: going round turns the picked run back to front
among says the letters lie within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Someone notes that the lazy people in the group never win anything.
explanation.walkthrough: RESOL sits inside 'theyRE SO Lazy'; 'going round' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is beaten in a contest has failed to win.

clue.text: Cereal providing sex appeal and energy

parts.note: SA is a dated abbreviation for sex appeal
go means energy or vigour

explanation.surface: A breakfast food claiming to give allure and vigour.
explanation.definitionFit: Sago is a starch from palm pith, used like a grain in puddings.

clue.text: Clap first two of them continuing below

indicators.note: first two of keeps only the opening pair of letters of the next word

parts.note: under means below

explanation.surface: Applaud the first two of them as they keep going beneath.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first two of' takes TH from 'them'.
explanation.definitionFit: A clap of thunder is a loud crack or peal, so clap names the sound.

clue.text: A musical group working in desert

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians
on means operating or working

explanation.surface: A group of musicians performing in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' is the verb, to leave behind, not the sandy noun.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon someone is to forsake or leave them.

clue.text: Very weary — do better with oars perhaps?

indicators.note: perhaps signals one possible arrangement of these letters, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rowing coach urges a tired crew to improve with their oars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges DO BETTER and OARS together.
explanation.definitionFit: To be bored to tears is to be utterly fed up through dullness.
